summary: Verified Back Story bug fix + LLM explainer + follow-up chat + Feed hint cleanup. Backend SSE endpoints (/api/insights/hot/backstory/stream and /chat/stream) return well-formed start→chunk*→done events with 4 section markers and 1400+ chars of plain-English explainer. Frontend on 428x900 mobile viewport: Back Story button on card 0 opens portal modal (hot-backstory-modal-0), streams a 4-section explainer, chat input+send produces a streamed answer, Close button closes modal AND card 0 is fully intact after close (490 chars text identical before/after). Backdrop click also closes modal. Feed page shows only 'Double-tap · deeper' hint — the 'tap a word · explain' pill is gone.
critical_code_review_comments: BackStorySheet portal correctly renders outside the <article>, which fixes the blank-card regression. The onClose is wired to the outer div's onClick and the inner sheet stops propagation — this is the correct pattern.

Backend uses model 'gpt-5.4-mini' via emergentintegrations — endpoints returned real content in ~5-8s, but the code does chat.send_message (non-streaming) then chunks the full response with 20ms sleeps. That is fine but is not true token streaming; consider migrating to send_message_stream if latency-to-first-token becomes a UX concern.
No visible dead code introduced; TappableText & the second hint span were cleanly removed per iteration_1 recommendations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testing on 428x900 mobile viewport worked. Mouse drag does NOT trigger the framer-motion touch swipe on Hot Now cards — the automation could only verify cards 0 and 1 via drag simulation; both stayed intact after Back Story open/close (backdrop click AND explicit Close). Because BackStorySheet uses ReactDOM.createPortal rendering to document.body OUTSIDE the <article>, all 12 cards inherit the same DOM isolation, so the fix is architectural and safe. If a future agent needs to programmatically swipe through all 12, dispatch synthetic Touch events or use page.touchscreen. The 'Double-tap · deeper' pill is present on /feed and the 'tap a word · explain' pill is confirmed gone. Backend endpoints /api/insights/hot/backstory/stream and /chat/stream are stable (3/3 pytests pass in ~8s).
rca of the issue: Original bug: Back Story modal was nested inside <article>, so its click/keyboard events could bubble into the swipe/card handler and, on unmount, sometimes left the card's parent in a state where the flex/absolute layout looked blank. Fix: BackStorySheet is now a top-level component rendered via ReactDOM.createPortal(document.body). The outer portal div has onClick={onClose} and the inner sheet does e.stopPropagation. This fully decouples modal lifecycle from the card DOM, eliminating the blank-card side-effect.
